summary: This bill repeals section 138 of the Clean Air Act, thereby eliminating the environmental and climate justice block grant program and rescinding any unspent funds allocated to it.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly repeals Section 138 of the Clean Air Act, which established environmental and climate justice block grants. By eliminating these grants, the bill removes a mechanism intended to address environmental and climate issues, particularly in disadvantaged communities, thus leading to less environmental protection.
